ui.tagline: Every star is a text from Dark Souls. The more two texts talk about the same things, the closer they sit.
ui.aria: Map of Dark Souls's texts: each star is a text, and texts close together talk about the same things. Arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, Enter to open the targeted star.
ui.credit: Dark Souls texts © FromSoftware / Bandai Namco. Non-commercial fan project.

uncertain_speakers.Unknown NPC: No source says who speaks these lines.
uncertain_speakers.Griggs of Vinheim: The Dark Souls wiki confirms 51 of 119 lines; the others are attributed by where they sit in the game files.
